attempts.summary: Deployed a rootless containerized web application (nginx:alpine) on node1, running entirely as the unprivileged appsvc account (uid 1001), serving on port 8080, and starting at boot via systemd user lingering with no active login session. Node1 is a 32-bit (i686) Ubuntu 16.04 host lacking upstream rootless-container binaries, so rootlesskit and slirp4netns were compiled from source (via a locally built Go 1.21 toolchain, ninja, and libslirp) to enable genuine rootless Docker on dockerd 18.09.7, wrapped with the official dockerd-rootless.sh/dockerd-rootless-setuptool.sh scripts. Worked around legacy-platform limitations: hardcoded /etc/docker/key.json permissions, a cgroup-v1-only 4.4 kernel (cgroup v1 controllers delegated to appsvc via a boot-time root systemd oneshot unit), and the lack of native rootlesskit port registration in dockerd 18.09 (automated via an ExecStartPost script calling the rootlesskit HTTP API). Verified full recovery across two independent reboots of node1: boot_id changed each time, appsvc's systemd user manager and docker.service came back automatically under lingering with no login session, the webapp container (restart=unless-stopped) resumed, port 8080 was reachable via NODE_IP, and all processes (rootlesskit/dockerd/containerd/docker-proxy/nginx) ran as uid 1001.
